title: prompt registration: register_prompt returns PromptVersion, and its docstrings in GenAI, fluent and MlflowClient must agree
answers: The register_prompt docs say it returns a Prompt, but the code gives a PromptVersion. Which is right?
Where are the register_prompt docstrings for the GenAI API, fluent registry and MlflowClient?
body:
Path: Prompt registration entry points: mlflow/genai/prompts/__init__.py:register_prompt (GenAI API), mlflow/tracking/_model_registry/fluent.py:register_prompt (fluent registry API), and mlflow/tracking/client.py:MlflowClient.register_prompt. A call creates a new version of a named prompt and hands back the created version.
Rule: The value returned is a PromptVersion (annotated `-> PromptVersion`), not the Prompt entity. Document it as `:py:class:`PromptVersion <mlflow.entities.PromptVersion>`` in the Returns section. When you edit one of the three register_prompt docstrings, update the other two so the public docs match the annotation and runtime behavior.
Symptom: The API reference said register_prompt returns a Prompt object, which contradicts the actual PromptVersion return value and the type annotation.
Constraints: Applies to the Returns text of register_prompt docstrings. It does not cover the Prompt entity itself or other prompt functions such as load or search.
applies: Documentation of MLflow prompt registration return values in the GenAI, fluent and client APIs.
says: The prompt registry documentation incorrectly states that registering a prompt returns the base entity.
Registering a new prompt returns a prompt version rather than the parent prompt.
Prompt registration return value documentation does not match the actual runtime behavior.
Make the return type description consistent across all prompt management documentation pages.
search: Prompt registration entry points in mlflow/genai/prompts/__init__.py:register_prompt, mlflow/tracking/_model_registry/fluent.py:register_prompt, and mlflow/tracking/client.py:MlflowClient.register_prompt return a PromptVersion (annotated -> PromptVersion). Docstrings must document the return value as :py:class:`PromptVersion <mlflow.entities.PromptVersion>` in the Returns section across all three files to keep public documentation in sync. This rule applies strictly to the Returns text of register_prompt docstrings and does not cover the Prompt entity itself or functions like load or search.
